subject: Re: Inquiry About Milkweed Fiber Samples for Evaluation

messages.subject: Inquiry About Milkweed Fiber Samples for Evaluation
messages.text:
Dear Lasclay Team,

 

 My name is Stefano Mangolini, and I am an Application Technologist at Huntsman Elastomers Europe.

 

 We are currently investigating the potential use of natural fibers in polyurethane elastomer applications and have developed a particular interest in milkweed fiber due to its unique lightweight and hollow structure.

 

 During our research, we came across Lasclay and were very interested in your expertise and activities related to milkweed materials. We would like to ask whether it would be possible to obtain a sample of your milkweed fiber for laboratory
 evaluation and feasibility studies within our development programs.

 

 Our objective is to better understand the processing behavior and potential benefits of this type of fiber in polyurethane systems. Any technical information regarding the material, its characteristics, and available grades would also be
 greatly appreciated.

 

 Additionally, our Legal Team has asked us to obtain confirmation that the milkweed fiber is fully processed and free of viable seeds, rhizomes, or any other propagative material.

 

 Could you please provide a signed declaration stating that the commercial fiber contains no viable seeds or vegetative propagules and is incapable of germination or regeneration?

 We would use this declaration to consult with the relevant authorities regarding import and regulatory compliance.

 

 Should you feel it would be beneficial, we would be happy to arrange a brief introductory call to present our activities, discuss our areas of interest, and explore potential opportunities for collaboration.

 

 Thank you for your time and consideration. We look forward to hearing from you.

 

 

 
 
 

 Best regards, 

 

 _____________________________
